title: Consolidated Operations Console logical data model
description: Phase 1 proposed normalized contracts. Source payloads are retained, not claimed to be complete native SDK schemas. Entity schemas describe one current publication; provider observations and immutable revisions remain separate.

Timestamp.description: Epoch seconds, millisecond precision. Validators must use decimal arithmetic before ordering; reject higher precision.

JsonValue.description: Retained native document content may be any JSON value; strict write DTOs never reuse this as their entire request.

EntityRef.description: An application identity in the containing workspace. Resolution must enforce the workspace, entity kind and parent ownership.

OwningScope.description: Resource owner, independent of the principal/connection used to observe it. Null is explicit global/not-applicable, never inferred from delivery recipient.

SourceIdentity.description: Stable native identity or explicit provisional source identity. Encode the complete tuple, never delimiter-join opaque components. Provider ARN aliases are preserved separately.

ActorRef.description: Authenticated human/service identity supplied by trusted runtime, not selected by request body.

ArtifactRef.description: Durable content locator with version and digest. A signed download URL is resolved separately and is never identity.

EvidenceRef.description: Immutable evidence reference with explicit type, in the same workspace.

FieldPresence.description: Presence is independent of value. Omitted detail cannot be converted into an empty collection.

Coverage.description: A bounded claim about a named query and time window; dimensions remain independent.

filters.description: Exact normalized structured filters; raw provider request pagination/ordering is pinned on each ReadAttempt.

CollectionQuery.description: Exact request scope and declared question; pagination is not a universal proof of completeness.

ReadError.description: Observed technical/authorization failure; never substitute zero rows for failure.

ProviderBinding.description: Explicit observed relationship between a canonical entity and provider object. Importing/binding never grants remote write authority.

ResourceMatch.description: Explicit evidence-backed match, including ambiguity. Identity is not inferred solely from a display string.

OrganizationMembership.description: External, time-bounded organization membership; unrelated to notification recipients.

OrganizationAccess.description: Observed AWS Health organization integration status. Configuration, access and collection coverage are distinct.

ServiceMembership.description: Sole writable workload membership authority is Service.memberships. Reverse journey/system service lists are projections.

LocalDecision.description: Independently versioned operator metadata; cannot rewrite provider evidence.

WorkAction.description: Immutable append-only operator action owned by a WorkItem; no standalone CRUD root.

CommandAttempt.description: Owned dispatch/reconciliation attempt. Acceptance, remote effect and local completion are independent.

ExternalOperationRef.description: Provider effect identity may be unknown after a lost response. originEffectKey exists before dispatch and remains stable.

EventDescription.description: Localized text belongs to an event revision, not a mutable global event field.

CommunicationPage.description: An immutable candidate page, not an independently writable entity. Conflicting candidates are retained, not overwritten.

LifecycleMilestone.description: Identity is milestoneKey within a pinned catalog revision. Raw provider date preserves date precision.

PolicyComponent.description: Only reviewed native component families; optional configured components determine the assessment denominator.

PolicyContext.description: Frozen selection of assignment and effective-target evidence. Captured context is not proof of the exact AWS-evaluated policy revision.

RecommendationEnrichment.description: Local estimate/owner/workflow with its own revision, independent of immutable suggestion evidence.

AgentAssociation.description: Provider-owned scoped association, never a business Service or product Connection. Built-in serviceId aws need not resolve to a registered provider.

TaskExecutionMembership.description: Observed request/response association, not inferred ownership. An Execution has no single investigationId.

ExternalReference.description: Native linked-incident reference; may remain unresolved after its integration disappears.

AssetVersion.description: Exact provider asset version with retained source revision. latest is never an archival reference.

AssetFile.description: A file is identified by owning asset version and exact path, including case.

GraphNode.description: Snapshot-owned node; unknown/inferred identity remains qualified.

GraphEdge.description: Snapshot-owned typed edge. Causal claim, dependency, provider topology and sequence are different meanings.

GraphContents.description: Nodes/edges belong to one immutable capture. Unresolved endpoints use explicitly marked nodes, never fabricated resources.

OperationLock.description: Publish resolves exact implementation and schema digests; execution never re-resolves a mutable alias.

inputBindings.description: Typed values/expressions checked against the operation lock input schema at publication.

StepDefinition.description: Owned scenario-revision step with stable stepKey. Native FIS actions are not these workflow steps.

inputSchema.description: Retained JSON Schema, validated as a schema and restricted to a closed top-level object at publication.

ScenarioDefinition.description: Bounded main and finalizer DAGs; language/operation contracts are pinned at publication.

Admission.description: Immutable run inputs, capabilities and criterion denominator. References grant no permission; trusted binding restricts effects.

CheckResult.description: Final immutable evaluation of one check. Missing evidence is not false, and technical success is not PASS.

CancellationIntent.description: First accepted intent is monotonic. Local cancellation cannot prove remote cessation.

CriterionResult.description: Assessment denominator is frozen; missing/skipped/error checks remain INCONCLUSIVE.

Evaluation.description: A new evaluation never overwrites the sealed run/experiment result it re-examines.

LifecycleExposure.description: Derived applicability with exact deployment, catalog revision, milestone and matching rule.

InvestigationResult.description: Phase-scoped selected result; completion events from another phase cannot replace it.

StateDimension.description: One independently meaningful status backed by explicit evidence.

ServiceStatus.description: Separate dimensions, selected policy context and explicit reasons. No universal healthy/successful flag.

WorkspaceSummary.description: One denominator of distinct authorized services. No denominator yields null percentage, not zero or 100.

FISAction.description: Native named action owned by an Experiment. Its state is read-only and cannot be stopped/restarted individually.

TargetMembership.description: Run-scoped resolved selection, never proof that fault was applied. Pod/container choices are different identity layers.

FISReport.description: Configured, absent configuration, unobserved and known report readiness are distinct.

Workspace.description: Application authorization and configuration boundary, distinct from AWS AgentSpace.

Connection.description: Access path/credential reference, not native owner identity. Secrets remain outside the model.

Resource.description: Canonical inventory identity with explicit stable or run-scoped boundary; does not represent all native objects.

Collection.description: A finite collection pass records its exact query set, including empty and failed reads.

ReadAttempt.description: A single request attempt exists even if it returned zero objects or failed. It is immutable once settled.

SourceRevision.description: Immutable distinct source payload/envelope for one identity, representation and content digest. Observation time is recorded separately.

Observation.description: Immutable receipt/read observation of one revision. Repeated polls do not create new logical objects. Event/stream/local receipts may have no ReadAttempt; no native read is fabricated.

ProjectionRevision.description: Immutable versioned derivation with retained inputs, coverage and rule digest. Current selection is a read view.

Snapshot.description: Immutable closed manifest and contents. CapturedAt never replaces provider/source time. Access remains checked on reads/exports.

WorkItem.description: Local operator workflow over typed domain targets; completion does not establish provider recovery or remediation.

Command.description: Durable intent and receipt; conditional local admission is not an AWS transaction. Unknown remote outcomes are reconciled without inventing success.

System.description: Business system. Provider system aliases are explicit; local metadata changes do not mutate AWS.

UserJourney.description: A user journey belongs to one system; its service set is derived from Service.memberships.

Service.description: Business workload boundary, distinct from an AWS service family and a RegisteredService integration.

Dependency.description: Scoped service dependency. Provider classification and local governance have separate authority and version ownership.

HealthEvent.description: Shared provider Health event identity. EventBridge envelope IDs and recipient accounts are not this identity.

EventContext.description: Public/account/organization-summary evidence partition. Context-specific state never leaks into another context.

EntityImpact.description: Event-relative affected-entity record, not an inventory Resource or a global health state.
EntityImpact.x-identity: workspaceId + eventContextId + scoped provider entity key

Communication.description: Validated logical Health communication grouping, preserving conflicting pages and per-recipient delivery observations.

LifecycleEntry.description: Provider lifecycle catalog entry has no established stable provider ID; retain snapshot identity and explicit match provenance.

ComponentDeployment.description: An observed installed component/version on a resource, with explicit inventory provenance.

ResiliencePolicy.description: Provider resilience policy. Configured components stay optional; latency is not invented as a native policy component.

ResilienceAssessment.description: Native service-scoped assessment execution; execution success, posture and runtime health remain independent.

Finding.description: Service-scoped finding with no mandatory assessment foreign key. Detail absence is distinct from zero suggestions.

Recommendation.description: Immutable suggested change anchored to one finding detail observation, group and ordinal. Later changed source content is a new recommendation.
Recommendation.x-identity: workspaceId + serviceId + findingId + detail observation + group + ordinal

AgentSpace.description: AWS workspace resource inside the application Workspace. Never merge it with the product authorization boundary.

Investigation.description: Native Task with taskType INVESTIGATION plus observed execution memberships and result views; no invented native GetInvestigation contract.

Execution.description: Native DevOps execution in an AgentSpace; task membership is an observed relation, not a single foreign key.

JournalRecord.description: Stable journal envelope identity with retained source revisions. Content stays arbitrary JSON; no assumed root-cause schema.

ApprovalRequest.description: Approval decision and resume are separate commands; neither is evidence of tool execution success.

Asset.description: Native asset root; exact versions and files retain immutable source/content references and availability.

Scenario.description: Editable scenario metadata and draft; executions reference a published immutable ScenarioRevision.

ScenarioRevision.description: Validated immutable definition with complete operation/schema locks. Alias changes cannot change published meaning.

Run.description: An admitted workflow execution; its phase, technical outcome, verdict and finalization remain separate.

StepRun.description: Run-owned step lifecycle. Selection of an attempt is explicit; retry history is retained.

StepAttempt.description: Immutable settled execution facts; late reconciliation adds observations without editing a sealed attempt.

Experiment.description: Native AWS FIS experiment, possibly linked to a workflow attempt but independently observable. Actions are provider-owned named values.

WorkflowPolicies.description: Main/finalization budgets and trusted deployment concurrency are independent.

BindingDeclaration.description: Authoring declaration resolved against an authorized connection at admission.

RetryPolicy.description: Bounded read retries. Mutating retries require trusted adapter capability and resolved previous effect.

inputSchema.description: Retained JSON Schema, validated as a schema and restricted to a closed top-level object at publication.

ScenarioDraft.description: Editable authoring document. Trusted publication resolves operation and schema locks; authors cannot grant capabilities by supplying a lock.

ResolvedBinding.description: Trusted admitted mapping from a declaration to a connection and constrained effect scope. A provider identity alone is not an access grant.

EvidenceLocator.description: Optional exact fragment attribution: JSON Pointer, asset path, or half-open Unicode code-point text offsets. Omitted locator means the entire retained value.

RecommendationEstimate.description: Local estimate with declared amount/currency/basis, complexity, source, time and confidence; separate from provider suggested-change evidence.

AssigneeRef.description: Resolved directory identity assigned to local work. A team/group is an assignee, never an authenticated audit actor.
